partner_terms_lead: Have a calm read before you start. It's short, promise!
partner_terms_accept_label: I've read the partnership terms and I accept them.
partner_terms_accept_required: To partner with us, read the terms and tick the box.
partner_terms_what_one: You introduce people with dogs who want training to Zurvann: with your own link, with a QR, or by entering their details in your account. These terms are the same for partners (businesses) and for customers who refer their friends. Training, prices and arranging the lessons are on Zurvann.
partner_terms_gift_one: A referral gift is written only when a customer you introduced buys a course and pays for it in full. It's a share of the courses bought in that payment, at the steps you see on your dashboard.
partner_terms_gift_two: Signing up, a free evaluation or a phone call earn no gift on their own. If a customer buys no course, there is no gift.
partner_terms_gift_three: Each customer belongs to one partner: a partner's link comes first; otherwise, the first partner who entered their details.
partner_terms_customers_one: Only enter someone you've actually talked to and who'd like Zurvann to call them.
partner_terms_customers_two: For each customer you write the mobile number, the guardian's name, the dog's name, breed and age. Bulk, made-up or unapproved numbers aren't allowed.
partner_terms_customers_three: A customer you entered can't be edited or deleted.
partner_terms_privacy_one: A customer's number and details are for this introduction only. Don't use them anywhere else or pass them on without their permission.
partner_terms_promise_one: Don't promise prices, discounts, dates or training results on Zurvann's behalf. A course costs what the site says.
partner_terms_paying_one: Zurvann pays gifts outside the site, to the Sheba number in your account, and marks them «Paid» on the site. Keeping your Sheba right is up to you.
partner_terms_stop_one: If these terms aren't kept (for example, made-up customers are entered), Zurvann can pause the partnership. From then on your link and entries don't bring anyone in under your name.
partner_terms_change_one: Whenever this text changes, you'll see the new version on your dashboard, and you can't enter new customers until you accept it.
